hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) if out=$(bunx eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1); then :; else jq -n --arg r "$out" '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; fi ;; esac; }

tc=$(bun run typecheck:next 2>&1); tc_code=$?; if [ $tc_code -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "typecheck failed:
$tc" '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; exit 0; fi; fa=$(fallow dead-code --changed-since main 2>&1); fa_code=$?; if [ $fa_code -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "fallow dead-code failed (boundary/circular-dependency violation):
$fa" '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running typecheck and fallow boundary/dead-code check...
